offering_description.value: Produces specialty catalysts, sulfuric acid and related chemicals, and provides sulfuric acid regeneration services. Sells to refiners, chemical producers, and industrial, water treatment and semiconductor customers, manufacturing at plants across North America and Europe.

primary_products.value: zeolite catalysts; silica catalysts and materials; virgin sulfuric acid; ammonium thiosulfate and other specialty chemicals

primary_services.value: sulfuric acid regeneration; spent acid processing for refineries
